name: Joël Legendre
bio: Joël Legendre is a Québec actor, voice actor, and radio host. He's a popular stage and TV actor who has also dubbed Hollywood actors like Leonardo DiCaprio and Neil Patrick Harris.

credits.title: Santa Claude
credits.overview: A distinguished lawyer who finds himself having to perform community service after committing a blunder: getting into a shouting match with a mascot during a Christmas parade.

credits.title: Extras
credits.overview: EXT. DAY - A sunny Sunday morning on a café terrace: Isabelle, an actress whose career is in a rut, meets Johanne, her agent, who might have a new part for her. Tension mounts both at the table and in the surroundings.

credits.title: Michèle, tout simplement
credits.overview: Discover in all intimacy the life of the singer and actress Michèle Richard. From her first performance on film at the age of ten until the acquisition of her new residence in the Laurentian Mountains.

credits.title: Juste Pour Rire 2017 - Gala Juste Sketchs
Les FantastiX : La magie des stars
credits.overview: The FantastiX, masters of illusion, mentalism, hypnosis, circus and magic, perform on stage and transmit their knowledge to artists who will blow everyone’s mind with their impressive magic numbers.

credits.title: Bittersweet Memories
credits.overview: 1952, Québec - Alys Robi, vocalist at the top of her popularity and recognized worldwide, was interned in spite of herself, by her father. Medical authorities prescribe her the only cure for a possible cure: the lobotomy. Under the bright lights of the operating room, Alys sees her 28-year life flash before her eyes.

credits.title: Louis the 19th, King of the Airwaves
credits.overview: Louis Jobin is an ordinary young man from Montreal who sells televisions at an electronics store. He wins a contest sponsored by the local cable company in which the first prize is that he'll be followed non-stop by a camera crew, with the footage broadcast live on Channel 19.
